room_or_space: SECOND FLOOR PLAN: porch, living room, central stair/chimney block, dining room, south balcony, study with north balcony, three halls, kitchen, pantry, closet, servant room, bath and quarters

overall_dimensions.length: 92'-0" (overall length of the main block as dimensioned along the north side; the porch extends a further 13'-0" + 8'-0" to the west on the bottom chain)
overall_dimensions.width: 20'-6" clear width of the living room between the prow flank walls, with 4'-0" flanks and 2'-4" piers dimensioned beyond on each side

proportions.length_to_width_ratio: about 4.5 : 1 (92'-0" overall length to 20'-6" clear living-room width)
proportions.notable_proportion: A 4'-0" column-grid module is repeated along both long sides and is sub-divided into 2'-9" leaf + 1'-3" pier along the glazed south wall; the living room's 20'-6" clear width is about five modules, and the prow bays at each end of the main block are set out on the same grid lines

layout.organisation: Very long, narrow linear plan made of two parallel bars offset from one another: the main bar runs porch - living room - central stair/chimney mass - dining room with a continuous south balcony, and a second service bar (study, halls, kitchen, pantry, closet, servant, bath, quarters) sits to the north-east, overlapping the main bar only at the halls behind the stair mass. Both ends of the main bar terminate in pointed prow bays.
layout.axes: One dominant east-west long axis through porch, living room, stair/chimney mass and dining room, with the two prows on that axis; the service wing is a parallel axis shifted north by 3'-6" and 1'-8" jogs in the north wall; the central stair/chimney mass sits on the long axis and divides it into two halves (living and dining).
layout.entry_sequence: No external door at this level. Stairs marked UP arrive from below at the west end (two flights flanking the porch/living-room junction), at the central stair/chimney block between living and dining room (one flight marked UP, one DOWN), and in the rear hall between kitchen and pantry (marked UP); a stair marked DOWN leads off the hall beside the study.
layout.circulation: Linear: porch -> living room -> past either side of the central stair/chimney mass -> dining room -> east prow. A hall behind the stair mass connects to the study and to the north balcony door, and continues east as a corridor/hall past kitchen and pantry to closet, servant room, bath and quarters. The south balcony runs the full length of living and dining rooms with 6'-0" bays marked OPEN at both ends; a small north balcony opens off the hall beside the study.

details: Pointed prow bays at both ends of the main block, formed by thin glazed angled walls between small hatched piers set on the long axis
A 4'-0" column-grid module drawn as faint construction lines across the whole sheet and expressed in the dimension chains on every side
Continuous band of glazed door leaves with swing arcs along the south wall, 2'-9" leaf plus 1'-3" pier per bay, opening onto the balcony
Central hatched stair/chimney mass with a pilastered east face (1'-2" / 3'-0" / 4'-0" / 3'-0" / 1'-2") dividing living and dining rooms, with open passages on both sides
Balconies and porch bounded by low parapet walls drawn as double lines with dash-dot centre lines, with OPEN bays at the balcony ends
